questions.ko: 내 계좌로 지금까지 들어온 이체는 몇 건이고 총액은 얼마인가요?
questions.question: For account number {a}: how many transfers has it received in total, and what is the total amount received?

questions.ko: 내 계좌에서 나간 이체 건수와 그 중 가장 큰 금액은?
questions.question: For account number {a}: how many outgoing transfers are there, and what is the single largest amount sent?

questions.ko: 내 계좌로 돈을 보낸 계좌 중 고위험 채널을 쓴 곳은 어디인가요?
questions.question: Which accounts sent money to account number {a} on a transfer whose own channel_risk property is 5 or more? Give the five lowest such account numbers in ascending order.

questions.ko: 내가 송금한 계좌들의 실제 소유자는 누구인가요?
questions.question: Who owns the accounts that account number {a} has sent money to? Give the five lowest owner ids in ascending order.

questions.ko: 내 돈이 두 단계 안에 닿는 계좌는 몇 개이고, 그 중 가장 위험한 등급은?
questions.question: Starting from account number {a} and following transfers downstream, how many distinct accounts are reachable within two hops, and what is the highest risk_tier among them?

questions.ko: 내 계좌로 두 단계 안에 돈이 흘러들어온 계좌는 몇 개인가요?
questions.question: How many distinct accounts sit within two transfer hops upstream of account number {a} — that is, accounts from which money reaches {a} in one or two transfers?

questions.ko: 전체 계좌 수와 최고위험(등급 5) 계좌 수는?
questions.question: How many accounts are there in total, and how many of them are at risk_tier 5?

questions.ko: 거래가 가장 많이 오간 채널 상위 5개는?
questions.question: Which five channels carry the most transactions? Give the channel codes in descending order of total transaction count.

questions.ko: 같은 사람이 소유한 계좌끼리 직접 송금이 오간 사례는 몇 건인가요?
questions.question: How many distinct ordered pairs of two *different* accounts owned by the same party have a direct transfer running from the first to the second? Count each pair once however many transfers run between them.

questions.ko: 100곳이 넘는 상대로부터 입금을 받은 계좌는 어디인가요?
questions.question: Which accounts received transfers from more than 100 distinct sending accounts? Give the five lowest such account numbers in ascending order.

questions.ko: 서로 돈이 오가고, 소유자끼리 보증을 서줬고, 같은 기기로 로그인한 계좌 쌍을 찾아주세요.
questions.question: Find pairs of accounts that satisfy all three of these at once: money has moved between them by transfer, their owners are different parties who guarantee one another, and the same login device has signed in to both. Give the account number pairs, smaller number first.

questions.ko: 서로 돈이 오가고, 소유자 중 한 쪽이 다른 쪽에 보증을 섰고, 같은 기기로 로그인한 계좌 쌍은?
questions.question: Find pairs of accounts that satisfy all three of these at once: money has moved between them by transfer in either direction, their owners are two different parties and one of them guarantees the other in either direction, and the same login device has signed in to both. Give the account number pairs, smaller number first.

questions.ko: 여러 차명계좌에서 한 계좌로 신고기준 아래 금액만 잘게 모으고 있는 사람은 누구인가요?
questions.question: Which party owns the largest number of distinct accounts that all send money into one single common account, where every one of those transfers is below the 10,000,000 reporting threshold? Give the owner id and how many of their accounts are involved.

calls.cypher:
MATCH (src:Account {_workspace_id: $workspace_id})- [r:TRANSFER]-> (dst:Account {_workspace_id: $workspace_id, acct_no: $a})
RETURN count(r) AS transfer_count, sum(r.amount) AS total_amount
LIMIT $limit
MATCH (src:Account {_workspace_id: $workspace_id, acct_no: $a})-[t:TRANSFER]->(dst:Account {_workspace_id: $workspace_id}) RETURN count(t) AS outgoing_count, max(t.amount) AS max_amount LIMIT $limit

MATCH (start:Account {_workspace_id: $workspace_id, acct_no: $a})
MATCH (start)-[:TRANSFER*1..2]->(reach:Account {_workspace_id: $workspace_id})
WITH DISTINCT reach
RETURN count(DISTINCT reach) AS reachable_count, max(reach.risk_tier) AS max_risk_tier
LIMIT $limit

MATCH (src:Account {_workspace_id: $workspace_id})-[:TRANSFER*1..2]->(tgt:Account {_workspace_id: $workspace_id, acct_no: $a})
WHERE src <> tgt
RETURN count(DISTINCT src) AS cnt
LIMIT $limit

MATCH (sender:Account {_workspace_id: $workspace_id})-[:TRANSFER {channel_risk: cr}]->(target:Account {_workspace_id: $workspace_id, acct_no: $a})
WHERE cr >= 5
RETURN DISTINCT sender.acct_no AS acct_no
ORDER BY acct_no ASC
LIMIT $limit

MATCH (sender:Account {_workspace_id: $workspace_id})-[t:TRANSFER]->(target:Account {_workspace_id: $workspace_id, acct_no: $a})
WHERE t.channel_risk >= 5
RETURN DISTINCT sender.acct_no AS acct_no
ORDER BY acct_no ASC
LIMIT $limit

MATCH (src:Account {_workspace_id: $workspace_id, acct_no: $a})-[:TRANSFER]->(dst:Account {_workspace_id: $workspace_id})
MATCH (owner:Person|Company {_workspace_id: $workspace_id})-[:OWN]->(dst)
WITH DISTINCT owner.id AS owner_id
ORDER BY owner_id ASC
LIMIT 5
RETURN owner_id
LIMIT $limit

MATCH (a:Account {_workspace_id: $workspace_id})
RETURN count(a) AS total_accounts,
       sum(CASE WHEN a.risk_tier = 5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS tier5_accounts
LIMIT $limit

MATCH (a:Account {_workspace_id: $workspace_id})-[r:USES_CHANNEL]->(c:Channel {_workspace_id: $workspace_id})
WITH c.code AS code, sum(r.tx_count) AS total_tx
ORDER BY total_tx DESC
LIMIT $limit
RETURN code

MATCH (m:Medium {_workspace_id: $workspace_id})-[:SIGN_IN]->(a:Account {_workspace_id: $workspace_id})
MATCH (m)-[:SIGN_IN]->(b:Account {_workspace_id: $workspace_id})
WHERE a <> b
MATCH (a)-[:TRANSFER]-(b)
MATCH (owner1:Person|Company {_workspace_id: $workspace_id})-[:OWN]->(a)
MATCH (owner2:Person|Company {_workspace_id: $workspace_id})-[:OWN]->(b)
WHERE owner1 <> owner2
MATCH (owner1)-[:GUARANTEE]->(owner2)
MATCH (owner2)-[:GUARANTEE]->(owner1)
WITH a,b
WHERE a.acct_no IS NOT NULL AND b.acct_no IS NOT NULL
WITH CASE WHEN a.acct_no <= b.acct_no THEN a.acct_no ELSE b.acct_no END AS acct1,

MATCH (a:Account {_workspace_id: $workspace_id})<-[:SIGN_IN]-(m:Medium {_workspace_id: $workspace_id})-[:SIGN_IN]->(b:Account {_workspace_id: $workspace_id})
WHERE a <> b
MATCH (a)-[:TRANSFER]->(b)
WITH a,b,m
MATCH (owner1:Person|Company {_workspace_id: $workspace_id})-[:OWN]->(a)
MATCH (owner2:Person|Company {_workspace_id: $workspace_id})-[:OWN]->(b)
WHERE owner1 <> owner2 AND (owner1)-[:GUARANTEE]->(owner2) AND (owner2)-[:GUARANTEE]->(owner1)
WITH a,b
WHERE a.acct_no IS NOT NULL AND b.acct_no IS NOT NULL
WITH CASE WHEN a.acct_no <= b.acct_no THEN a.acct_no ELSE b.acct_no END AS acct1,

MATCH (m:Medium {_workspace_id: $workspace_id})-[:SIGN_IN]->(a:Account {_workspace_id: $workspace_id})
MATCH (m)-[:SIGN_IN]->(b:Account {_workspace_id: $workspace_id})
WHERE a <> b
MATCH (a)-[:TRANSFER]-(b)
RETURN a.acct_no AS a1, b.acct_no AS b1 LIMIT $limit

MATCH (m:Medium {_workspace_id: $workspace_id})-[:SIGN_IN]->(a:Account {_workspace_id: $workspace_id})
MATCH (m)-[:SIGN_IN]->(b:Account {_workspace_id: $workspace_id})
WHERE a <> b
MATCH (a)-[:TRANSFER]-(b)
MATCH (owner1:Person|Company {_workspace_id: $workspace_id})-[:OWN]->(a)
MATCH (owner2:Person|Company {_workspace_id: $workspace_id})-[:OWN]->(b)
WHERE owner1 <> owner2 AND (
      (owner1)-[:GUARANTEE]->(owner2) OR (owner2)-[:GUARANTEE]->(owner1)
)
WITH a,b
WHERE a.acct_no IS NOT NULL AND b.acct_no IS NOT NULL
WITH CASE WHEN a.acct_no <= b.acct_no THEN a.acct_no ELSE b.acct_no END AS acct1

MATCH (m:Medium {_workspace_id: $workspace_id})-[:SIGN_IN]->(a:Account {_workspace_id: $workspace_id})
MATCH (m)-[:SIGN_IN]->(b:Account {_workspace_id: $workspace_id})
WHERE a <> b
MATCH (a)-[:TRANSFER]-(b)
MATCH (owner1:Person|Company {_workspace_id: $workspace_id})-[:OWN]->(a)
MATCH (owner2:Person|Company {_workspace_id: $workspace_id})-[:OWN]->(b)
WHERE owner1 <> owner2
AND (owner1)-[:GUARANTEE]->(owner2)
AND (owner2)-[:GUARANTEE]->(owner1)
WITH a,b
WHERE a.acct_no IS NOT NULL AND b.acct_no IS NOT NULL
WITH CASE WHEN a.acct_no <= b.acct_no THEN a.acct_no ELSE b.acct_no END AS acct1,

MATCH (a:Account {_workspace_id: $workspace_id})-[:TRANSFER]-(b:Account {_workspace_id: $workspace_id})
MATCH (o1:Person {_workspace_id: $workspace_id})-[:OWN]->(a)
MATCH (o2:Person {_workspace_id: $workspace_id})-[:OWN]->(b)
WHERE o1 <> o2 AND ((o1)-[:GUARANTEE]->(o2) OR (o2)-[:GUARANTEE]->(o1))
MATCH (m:Medium {_workspace_id: $workspace_id})-[:SIGN_IN]->(a)
MATCH (m)-[:SIGN_IN]->(b)
WITH a, b
WHERE a.acct_no IS NOT NULL AND b.acct_no IS NOT NULL
WITH CASE WHEN a.acct_no < b.acct_no THEN a.acct_no ELSE b.acct_no END AS acct1,
     CASE WHEN a.acct_no < b.acct_no THEN b.acct_no ELSE a.acct_no

MATCH (a:Account {_workspace_id: $workspace_id})-[:TRANSFER]-(b:Account {_workspace_id: $workspace_id})
MATCH (owner1:`Person|Company` {_workspace_id: $workspace_id})-[:OWN]->(a)
MATCH (owner2:`Person|Company` {_workspace_id: $workspace_id})-[:OWN]->(b)
WHERE owner1 <> owner2 AND ((owner1)-[:GUARANTEE]->(owner2) OR (owner2)-[:GUARANTEE]->(owner1))
MATCH (m:Medium {_workspace_id: $workspace_id})-[:SIGN_IN]->(a)
MATCH (m)-[:SIGN_IN]->(b)
WITH a, b
WHERE a.acct_no IS NOT NULL AND b.acct_no IS NOT NULL
WITH CASE WHEN a.acct_no < b.acct_no THEN a.acct_no ELSE b.acct_no END AS acct1,
     CASE WHEN

MATCH (a:Account {_workspace_id: $workspace_id})-[:TRANSFER]-(b:Account {_workspace_id: $workspace_id})
WHERE a.acct_no IS NOT NULL AND b.acct_no IS NOT NULL AND a <> b
MATCH (owner1:Person|Company {_workspace_id: $workspace_id})-[:OWN]->(a)
MATCH (owner2:Person|Company {_workspace_id: $workspace_id})-[:OWN]->(b)
WHERE owner1 <> owner2 AND ((owner1)-[:GUARANTEE]->(owner2) OR (owner2)-[:GUARANTEE]->(owner1))
MATCH (m:Medium {_workspace_id: $workspace_id})-[:SIGN_IN]->(a)
MATCH (m)-[:SIGN_IN]->(b)
WITH a,b
WHERE a.acct_no < b.acct_no
RETURN DISTINCT a.acct_no AS acct1, b.acct_no AS acct2
ORDER B

MATCH (src:Account {_workspace_id: $workspace_id})-[:TRANSFER {amount: a}]->(tgt:Account {_workspace_id: $workspace_id})
WHERE a < 10000000
MATCH (owner)-[:OWN]->(src)
WHERE owner._workspace_id = $workspace_id
WITH owner.id AS owner_id, tgt.id AS target_id, count(DISTINCT src) AS cnt
WITH owner_id, max(cnt) AS max_cnt
ORDER BY max_cnt DESC
LIMIT $limit

MATCH (src:Account {_workspace_id: $workspace_id})- [t:TRANSFER]->(tgt:Account {_workspace_id: $workspace_id})
WHERE t.amount < 10000000
MATCH (owner)-[:OWN]->(src)
WHERE owner._workspace_id = $workspace_id
WITH owner.id AS owner_id, tgt.id AS target_id, count(DISTINCT src) AS cnt
WITH owner_id, max(cnt) AS max_cnt
ORDER BY max_cnt DESC
LIMIT $limit
RETURN owner_id, max_cnt

MATCH (owner:Person|Company {_workspace_id: $workspace_id})-[:OWN]->(a:Account {_workspace_id: $workspace_id})-[:TRANSFER]->(b:Account {_workspace_id: $workspace_id})
WHERE a <> b
MATCH (owner)-[:OWN]->(b)
RETURN count(DISTINCT a,b) AS pair_count
LIMIT $limit

MATCH (owner:Person|Company {_workspace_id: $workspace_id})-[:OWN]->(a:Account {_workspace_id: $workspace_id})-[:TRANSFER]->(b:Account {_workspace_id: $workspace_id})
WHERE a <> b
MATCH (owner)-[:OWN]->(b)
WITH DISTINCT a,b
RETURN count(*) AS pair_count
LIMIT $limit

MATCH (sender:Account {_workspace_id: $workspace_id})-[:TRANSFER]->(beneficiary:Account {_workspace_id: $workspace_id})
WITH beneficiary, count(DISTINCT sender) AS senderCount
WHERE senderCount > 100
RETURN beneficiary.acct_no AS acct_no
ORDER BY acct_no ASC
LIMIT $limit

MATCH (src:Account {_workspace_id: $workspace_id})-[t:TRANSFER]->(dest:Account {_workspace_id: $workspace_id, acct_no: $a}) RETURN count(t) AS transfer_count, sum(t.amount) AS total_amount LIMIT $limit
MATCH (a:Account {_workspace_id: $workspace_id, acct_no: $a})-[t:TRANSFER]->(b:Account {_workspace_id: $workspace_id}) RETURN count(t) AS outgoing_count, max(t.amount) AS max_amount LIMIT $limit

MATCH (start:Account {_workspace_id: $workspace_id, acct_no: $a})-[:TRANSFER*1..2]->(reach:Account {_workspace_id: $workspace_id})
RETURN count(DISTINCT reach) AS reachable_count, max(reach.risk_tier) AS max_risk_tier
LIMIT $limit

MATCH (target:Account {_workspace_id: $workspace_id, acct_no: $a})
MATCH (src:Account {_workspace_id: $workspace_id})-[:TRANSFER*1..2]->(target)
WHERE src <> target
RETURN count(DISTINCT src) AS cnt LIMIT $limit

MATCH (sender:Account {_workspace_id: $workspace_id})-[:TRANSFER]->(target:Account {_workspace_id: $workspace_id, acct_no: $a})
MATCH (sender)-[:USES_CHANNEL]->(ch:Channel {_workspace_id: $workspace_id})
WHERE ch.risk_weight >= 5
RETURN sender.acct_no AS acct_no
ORDER BY sender.acct_no ASC
LIMIT $limit

MATCH (sender:Account {_workspace_id: $workspace_id})-[:TRANSFER]->(target:Account {_workspace_id: $workspace_id, acct_no: $a})
MATCH (sender)-[:USES_CHANNEL]->(ch:Channel {_workspace_id: $workspace_id})
WHERE ch.risk_weight >= 5 AND sender.acct_no <> $a
RETURN DISTINCT sender.acct_no AS acct_no
ORDER BY sender.acct_no ASC
LIMIT $limit

MATCH (src:Account {_workspace_id: $workspace_id, acct_no: $a})-[:TRANSFER]->(dst:Account {_workspace_id: $workspace_id})<-[:OWN]-(owner {_workspace_id: $workspace_id})
RETURN owner.id AS owner_id
ORDER BY owner_id ASC
LIMIT $limit

MATCH (src:Account {_workspace_id: $workspace_id, acct_no: $a})-[:TRANSFER]->(dst:Account {_workspace_id: $workspace_id})<-[:OWN]-(owner {_workspace_id: $workspace_id})
RETURN DISTINCT owner.id AS owner_id
ORDER BY owner_id ASC
LIMIT $limit

MATCH (a:Account {_workspace_id: $workspace_id})
RETURN count(a) AS total_accounts,
       count(CASE WHEN a.risk_tier = 5 THEN a END) AS risk_tier_5
LIMIT $limit

MATCH (src:Account {_workspace_id: $workspace_id})-[:TRANSFER]->(dst:Account {_workspace_id: $workspace_id}),
      (src)-[:USES_CHANNEL]->(c:Channel {_workspace_id: $workspace_id})
RETURN c.code AS channel_code, count(*) AS txCount
ORDER BY txCount DESC
LIMIT $limit

MATCH (a1:Account {_workspace_id: $workspace_id})-[:TRANSFER]-(a2:Account {_workspace_id: $workspace_id})
WHERE a1.acct_no < a2.acct_no
MATCH (owner1)-[:OWN]->(a1)
WHERE (owner1:_workspace_id) IS NOT NULL // placeholder

MATCH (a1:Account {_workspace_id: $workspace_id})-[:TRANSFER]-(a2:Account {_workspace_id: $workspace_id})
WHERE a1.acct_no < a2.acct_no
MATCH (owner1 {_workspace_id: $workspace_id})-[:OWN]->(a1)
MATCH (owner2 {_workspace_id: $workspace_id})-[:OWN]->(a2)
WHERE owner1 <> owner2
MATCH (owner1)-[:GUARANTEE]->(owner2)
MATCH (owner2)-[:GUARANTEE]->(owner1)
MATCH (m:Medium {_workspace_id: $workspace_id})-[:SIGN_IN]->(a1)
MATCH (m)-[:SIGN_IN]->(a2)
RETURN a1.acct_no AS acct1, a2.acct_no AS acct2
LIMIT $limit

MATCH (a1:Account {_workspace_id: $workspace_id})-[:TRANSFER]-(a2:Account {_workspace_id: $workspace_id})
WHERE a1.acct_no < a2.acct_no
MATCH (owner1 {_workspace_id: $workspace_id})-[:OWN]->(a1)
MATCH (owner2 {_workspace_id: $workspace_id})-[:OWN]->(a2)
WHERE owner1 <> owner2 AND (owner1)-[:GUARANTEE]-(owner2)
MATCH (m:Medium {_workspace_id: $workspace_id})-[:SIGN_IN]->(a1)
MATCH (m)-[:SIGN_IN]->(a2)
RETURN a1.acct_no AS acct1, a2.acct_no AS acct2
LIMIT $limit

MATCH (a:Account {_workspace_id: $workspace_id})-[:TRANSFER]-(b:Account {_workspace_id: $workspace_id})
WHERE a.acct_no < b.acct_no
MATCH (o1:Person|Company {_workspace_id: $workspace_id})-[:OWN]->(a)
MATCH (o2:Person|Company {_workspace_id: $workspace_id})-[:OWN]->(b)
WHERE o1 <> o2
MATCH (m:Medium {_workspace_id: $workspace_id})-[:SIGN_IN]->(a)
MATCH (m)-[:SIGN_IN]->(b)
WHERE (o1)-[:GUARANTEE]->(o2) OR (o2)-[:GUARANTEE]->(o1)
RETURN a.acct_no AS acct1, b.acct_no AS acct2
ORDER BY acct1, acct2
LIMIT $limit

MATCH (owner)-[:OWN]->(src:Account {_workspace_id: $workspace_id})
MATCH (src)-[:TRANSFER]->(tgt:Account {_workspace_id: $workspace_id})
WITH owner, tgt, count(DISTINCT src) as cnt
ORDER BY cnt DESC
LIMIT $limit
RETURN owner.id as owner_id, cnt as account_count

MATCH (owner)-[:OWN]->(src:Account {_workspace_id: $workspace_id})
MATCH (src)-[t:TRANSFER]->(tgt:Account {_workspace_id: $workspace_id})
WHERE t.amount < 10000000
WITH owner.id AS owner_id, tgt, count(DISTINCT src) AS cnt
ORDER BY cnt DESC
LIMIT $limit
RETURN owner_id, cnt

MATCH (owner:Person|Company {_workspace_id:$workspace_id})-[:OWN]->(a1:Account {_workspace_id:$workspace_id})-[:TRANSFER]->(a2:Account {_workspace_id:$workspace_id})
WHERE a1 <> a2 AND (owner)-[:OWN]->(a2)
WITH DISTINCT a1.acct_no AS acct1, a2.acct_no AS acct2
RETURN count(*) AS pairCount
LIMIT $limit

MATCH (src:Account {_workspace_id: $workspace_id})-[:TRANSFER]->(tgt:Account {_workspace_id: $workspace_id})
WITH tgt, count(DISTINCT src) AS cnt
WHERE cnt > 100
RETURN tgt.acct_no AS acct_no
ORDER BY acct_no ASC
LIMIT $limit
